sql: with f as (select fl.market_ticker, split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',1) as series, min(fl.filled_at) as filled_at, min(lo.created_at) as placed_at from fills fl join live_orders lo on lo.kalshi_order_id=fl.kalshi_order_id where lo.strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and lo.side='no' and lo.action='buy' and lo.limit_price between 90 and 95 and split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXFEDMENTION','KXINX','KXINXU','KXNASDAQ100U','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXWCMENTION') group by 1,2), h as (select f.*, (select t.hours_to_close from mmsell_candidate_ticks t where t.market_ticker=f.market_ticker and t.captured_at<=f.filled_at order by t.captured_at desc limit 1) - extract(epoch from (f.filled_at - (select t.captured_at from mmsell_candidate_ticks t where t.market_ticker=f.market_ticker and t.captured_at<=f.filled_at order by t.captured_at desc limit 1)))/3600.0 as htc_at_fill, extract(epoch from (filled_at-placed_at))/60.0 as wait_min from f), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) select case when series in ('KXTRUMPSAY','KXFEDMENTION','KXWCMENTION') then 'mentions' when series='KXRAIN' then 'rain' else 'index' end as grp, case when htc_at_fill is null then 'z?' when htc_at_fill<1 then 'a <1h' when htc_at_fill<4 then 'b 1-4h' when htc_at_fill<12 then 'c 4-12h' else 'd 12h+' end as at_fill, count(*) as mkts, sum(case when p.realized_pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end) as losers, round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by wait_min)::numeric,0) as med_wait_min from h left join p using (market_ticker) group by 1,2 order by 1,2
